name: Sci-Fi Operator
description: A grounded science-fiction setup for pilots, engineers, agents, researchers, and other capable specialists.

foundation.setting: A near- or far-future society where advanced technology creates practical opportunities and moral complications
foundation.role: Highly capable specialist whose professional competence hides a difficult personal pressure
foundation.core_hook: Tie the character's expertise to a problem they cannot solve through skill alone.

scene.opening_direction: Open during a technical, operational, or political complication that forces cooperation.
